author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell Brand sits down with Tucker Carlson to explore a question many people are starting to ask: where does real power actually sit?

From high-profile political meetings to global summits, the conversation challenges whether what we see publicly reflects who is truly making decisions. If outcomes remain consistent regardless of leadership changes, it raises questions about deeper structures, influence, and how power operates behind the scenes.
title: Who’s really behind it all?
